title: Your life feels flat because it's *predictable*

text: Dopamine spikes hardest when a reward is *unexpected,* not guaranteed.

head: Your Saturday
l: Same bar, same 3 guys, same talk
r: A class where you know nobody

head: Where you get surprise
r: A new trail, a new city, a new skill

items.head: Say yes to one invite
items.sub: Even the one you'd normally skip.

items.head: Start something you might fail
items.sub: A tryout, a pitch, a first lesson.

text: Playing it safe feels comfortable. It never feels *exciting.*
